title: better_errors debug page disclosed in a response
description: The response is the better_errors gem page: it references the gem and renders its Better Errors heading with the exception, the stack and a live console prompt. In many configurations that prompt evaluates Ruby expressions inside the failing request.
remediation: Remove the better_errors gem from the production bundle and keep it in the development group of the Gemfile.
limitation: Two body markers. A generic Rails stack frame is reported by the Rails stack rule; this rule requires the gem's own page markers.

observation.body: We are sorry, but something went wrong.
